method: Direct inspection of six timestamp-matched source/commanded/measured RGB thumbnails; unblinded qualitative assessment, not full-video review.
observations: Both arms keep the table and wall displays recognizable, with the first-boundary contrast pulse.
Commanded late frames introduce a blue/red foreground display on the right; measured late frames introduce a different large foreground column/display, especially at frame 336.
These foreground structures are absent from the matched reference; lower pose errors do not establish preserved scene fidelity.
Mean position is 37.31% lower and mean rotation 12.80% lower; this remains a pose/appearance tradeoff.
classification: Numeric pose improvement with substantial foreground hallucination in both arms; visual fidelity tradeoff.
temporal_limitation: Static sampled thumbnails do not resolve physical camera reversal, exclude between-sample collapse, or quantify perceptual video quality.
